user_bio: I build n8n-nodes-soterai, a community node that brings LLM security directly into your workflows — detect prompt injection attempts and flag risky AI-agent inputs before they reach your models, without leaving n8n. Backed by Soter, an OWASP LLM Top 10–aligned security engine I'm building from the ground up. Full Stack Developer by background (TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, LLMs , N8N), now focused on making AI security automatable for anyone running LLM-powered workflows.
